RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel is poor recruitment practice and increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias, but it is not definitive proof of discrimination. The successful candidate also presented relevant qualifications and specific international project leadership experience that may have aligned with the role's priorities.

Whether you should raise it depends on your jurisdiction's civil service rules. First, follow up on your delayed feedback. Simultaneously, check whether ministry policy mandates gender-balanced interview panels; if so, you can raise a procedural breach objectively. Avoid alleging sex discrimination until you have inspected the written scoring, competency benchmarks, and official feedback rationale.
